locator: 70023: exact amendment of pre-vote fee authority
passage: SEC. 70023. AMENDMENT TO AUTHORITY TO APPLY FOR ASYLUM. Section 208(d)(3) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1158(d)(3)) is amended-- (1) in the first sentence, by striking ``may'' and inserting ``shall''; (2) by striking ``Such fees shall not exceed'' and all that follows; and (3) by inserting after the first sentence ``Nothing in this paragraph shall be construed to limit the authority of the Attorney General to set additional adjudication and naturalization fees in accordance with section 286(m).''. PART 2--USE OF FUNDS
